description: Static files from public/ (/images/*, /Favicon/*, /favicon.ico): Next sends max-age=0, so without this every request revalidated with Hostinger. Keep 30 days at the edge (purged on every deploy), 4 h in browsers; never store errors
expression: (http.host eq "1think2win.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/images/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/Favicon/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/favicon.ico"))
